letterText: A sheet of paper can fly. Fold it into an airplane and carry it to the edge.

results.name: dev server up, started by this run
level 3 starts after level 2, with the paper its flag gave in slot 1
the letter lies on the floor just in front of the start
the letter is drawn on the floor
before the letter is read, the paper in his hand has no use, and no key is shown
results.details: item use: null, 0 pencil pixels in the bottom left

results.name: J changed nothing, and he walks on with the paper put back
next to the letter, K would read it
K shows the letter: the sim says he reads it, and its text is its def's
results.details: A sheet of paper can fly. Fold it into an airplane and carry it to the edge.

results.name: the text is written on the screen
results.details: 0 pencil pixels in the top middle before, 8498 while reading

results.name: reading taught the paper airplane, the only recipe he knows, and the letter says so
reading put the paper in his hand, and while he reads only K has a use: it puts the letter away
J while he reads does nothing: the letter stays up and the paper stays paper
K puts the letter away: it is gone from the level and from the screen
with the letter away, J would fold the paper airplane, and the key and what it does are written in the bottom left
results.details: item use: craft, 1342 pencil pixels in the bottom left

results.name: one press of J turns the paper into an airplane in the same slot
J with the airplane puts it on the floor in front of him and empties the slot
the airplane is drawn on the floor, and nothing over his head
next to it, K would lift it
K lifts it over his head
the airplane is drawn over his head, and no longer on the floor
a jump with it keeps it over his head
while he walks the airplane is drawn over his head
results.details: 351 pencil pixels over his head mid-walk

results.name: he carries it as he walks: on every frame the sim has it over his feet
results.details: 151 frames, 5.5 m, never more than 0 m apart

results.name: while he carries it, K would put it down
K near the edge puts it down in front of him, sitting on the edge with its nose out over the gap
results.details: middle at 9.68, nose at 10.38, edge at 10

results.name: there, K would board it (boarding itself is the next ticket), and pressing it changes nothing yet
it stays on the edge and no letter falls: nothing is lost
carrying shortens the jump
no page errors
